title: When Prophecy Fails: 1950s Ohio UFO cult
summary: Jesse Michels tells of When Prophecy Fails: 1950s Ohio UFO cult, about 1950s at Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when prophecy fails was this like you know in the the 50s there was this cult created in Ohio

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up When Prophecy Fails, a book about a group that formed in Ohio in the 1950s around beliefs tied to UFOs. He calls it a cult and mentions it while talking about how people hold on to beliefs about prophecies and a coming final event.
